question: Approve the ideation design — one tolerated sibling-channel uninstall step in installArgvSequence, doctor visibility split out to a follow-up, value proven by a claude-on-PATH count test with a validation obligation that a SKIP is a failure?

artifacts.summary: Design: add plugin uninstall spacedock@<otherChannelMarketplace> as tolerated step 2, mirroring codex; 6 production lines, the rest is the value test's two-channel local marketplace fixture. Two spikes run: claude 2.1.226 real uninstall semantics (absent sibling exits 1 with two different messages — forces tolerance; present sibling removes cleanly, survivor stays enabled, no cascade; end-to-end current 1->2 enabled vs proposed 1->1, fresh box and reverse direction green) and the fixture proven buildable offline. Doctor half split out as Needs-decision (gateHost fail-fast could refuse launch on dual-install machines) — follow-up seed filed. Estimate revised up from seed +40/4 to net +130/6 files, tolerance ±40/±1 (fixture is the bulk). Semantic change declared: a deliberately-held dual install is removed on next install/auto-heal. claude-live NOT required (ensigncycle has no install-path reference); detached adversarial audit REQUIRED (front-door + AC-provenance triggers). Value test skips in CI build; validation must run it locally, SKIP is not a pass.
